Home.brandingDescription: Your personal weightlifting companion. Track PRs, follow structured cycles, and watch yourself grow stronger every week.

new.brandingDescription: Enter your current PRs and pick a start date to generate your personalized training program.

onboarding.unlockTrainingPlanDescription: Your PRs power your personalized program
